steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Mise en place means 'everything in its place' — preparing and organising all ingredients and equipment before cooking begins, ensuring efficient and safe food preparation. | Key Fact: The bridge grip is used to hold food securely when cutting: form a bridge with thumb and fingers over the food, guiding the knife underneath. Used for cutting foods in half. | Key Fact: The claw grip is used for slicing and chopping: curl fingers inward like a claw, with fingertips behind the knuckles, guiding the knife while keeping fingers safe. | Key Fact: Knife types and uses: chef's knife (general chopping), paring knife (small precision work), bread knife (serrated for bread), filleting knife (flexible for fish), carving knife (slicing cooked meat).
